authority: Independently authored before execution; private selected-set/custody proof only, not host HTML diagnostics or wrapper acceptance.

cases.name: genuine-html-defaults
cases.rationale: walk.rs hidden(false), generic/global false, exact extension and basename-min filters; unignored node_modules is eligible.

cases.name: vcs-pruning-negation-index
cases.rationale: Git ancestor pruning; valid file reinclusion under allowed open dir; forced tracked ignored original remains excluded because index is not consulted.

cases.name: explicit-ignored-file
cases.rationale: lint.rs 1.78 applies is_gitignored to all roots; 1.86 applies is_gitignored_walk_root only to directories.

cases.name: explicit-ignored-file-no-ignore
cases.rationale: --no-ignore disables custom/CLI, not VCS; preserve exact host explicit-file distinction.

cases.name: ignored-directory-root
cases.rationale: Both hosts prefilter directory roots before Walk's depth-zero exception.

cases.name: bare-ancestor-root
cases.rationale: IncrementalIgnore rooted at Git boundary detects bare directory patterns and ancestors, not only literal final root.

cases.name: custom-whitelist-over-vcs-discovery
cases.rationale: dir.rs custom ignore match has priority over Git ignore during descendant traversal; do not hand-AND.

cases.name: custom-parent-pruning
cases.rationale: A child whitelist cannot reopen a custom-ignored parent directory.

cases.name: explicit-custom-parent-direct-match
cases.rationale: Explicit-file custom prefilter uses matched(path,false), not any parents; explicit walk root bypasses traversal pruning.

cases.name: explicit-custom-exclusion
cases.rationale: Explicit-file prefilter independently ORs CLI with standalone custom Gitignore before VCS root phase.

cases.name: cli-original-exclusion
cases.rationale: OverrideBuilder receives the exact prefixed !**/Skipped.html string.

cases.name: cli-leading-bang-is-literal
cases.rationale: User !name.html becomes !!name.html; one bang is parsed, remaining literal bang matches only !name.html.

cases.name: no-ignore-retains-config-vcs
cases.rationale: Custom/CLI disabled; root config and VCS remain independently active in provider order.

cases.name: config-file-whitelist-under-parent
cases.rationale: Config matched_path_or_any_parents checks full file first; whitelist retains Keep below config-ignored parent without pruning that parent.

cases.name: config-relative-nested-cwd
cases.rationale: Explicit root JSON is relative to actual nested cwd; repository ancestor ignore remains active.

cases.name: info-exclude-with-git-whitelist
cases.rationale: Repository Gitignore whitelist precedes info/exclude ignore.

cases.name: custom-filename
cases.rationale: Actual add_custom_ignore_filename preserves a caller-selected single filename and nested matching roots.

cases.name: malformed-json
cases.rationale: Bounded refusal preserves original config failure bytes; not host CLI error parity.

cases.name: inherited-config
cases.rationale: No detached inheritance authority.

cases.name: override-config
cases.rationale: No unqualified override config envelopes.

cases.name: nested-config
cases.rationale: Explicit refusal prevents silently using root ignores for a nested authority.

cases.name: wildcard-target
cases.rationale: Literal target provenance is mandatory.

cases.name: missing-target
cases.rationale: Missing source is explicit failure, not empty selected set.

cases.name: invalid-cli-pattern
cases.rationale: OverrideBuilder disables unclosed character classes; original CLI bytes survive refusal.

cases.name: invalid-cli-disabled
cases.rationale: --no-ignore skips CLI matcher construction, even malformed strings.

cases.name: symlink-explicit
cases.rationale: No original-path symlink credit.

cases.name: symlink-discovery
cases.rationale: Same collector refuses symlink before follow_links descent; no recursive prewalk.

cases.name: linked-git
cases.rationale: Linked metadata is explicitly outside finite envelope.

cases.name: nested-vcs
cases.rationale: One repository boundary only; same traversal refuses nested marker before descent.

cases.name: jj-metadata
cases.rationale: Jujutsu is not incidental Git acceptance.

cases.name: non-string-config-pattern
cases.rationale: Actual JSON authority must contain string patterns.

cases.name: explicit-vcs-metadata-root
cases.rationale: Oxlint visitor prunes metadata even at depth zero, where ignore filter_entry is bypassed.

cases.name: fifo-descendant
cases.rationale: Finite regular-file envelope refuses FIFO before source read; never encode a partial selected set.

cases.name: suppression-state
cases.rationale: Exact host suppression filename is oxlint-suppressions.json without a leading dot; no suppression support is inferred.

cases.name: symlink-gitignore
cases.rationale: Referenced Git authority must be regular before matching reads it.

cases.name: symlink-custom-ignore
cases.rationale: Referenced custom authority must be regular before matching reads it.

cases.name: symlink-root-config
cases.rationale: Explicit JSON authority is the original regular file, never linked bytes.

cases.name: symlink-info-directory
cases.rationale: Git info ancestor must be regular even when exclude is readable through a link.

cases.name: symlink-target-ancestor
cases.rationale: Original path ancestors are checked with symlink_metadata, preserving the target spelling.

cases.name: missing-git-boundary
cases.rationale: Nonrepository behavior is explicitly outside finite profile, not substituted with repository defaults.

cases.name: custom-path-refusal
cases.rationale: add_custom_ignore_filename envelope is one literal filename; path-bearing custom sources remain unqualified.

cases.name: malformed-custom-ignore
cases.rationale: Present malformed authority is a profile refusal with bytes; stock CLI discards some parse errors and is not claimed equivalent.

cases.name: deeper-vcs-directory-whitelist
cases.rationale: A deeper Gitignore whitelist may reopen the directory before it is pruned; root IncrementalIgnore honors hierarchy.

cases.name: config-reversed-negation
cases.rationale: Later root config ignore overrides earlier file whitelist; ordered matching is retained.

cases.name: nested-dangling-ignored-marker
cases.rationale: Present nested marker is detected with symlink_metadata before descent even if dangling and its spelling is ignored.
